sloka: महागजैश्चापि तथा नदद्भिः ।सुपूजितैश्चापि तथा सुसद्भिः ।रराज वीरैश्च विनिःश्वसद्भि ।र्ह्रदो भुजङ्गैरिव निःश्वसद्भिः ॥५-५-१४॥
transliteration: mahāgajaiścāpi tathā nadadbhiḥ ।supūjitaiścāpi tathā susadbhiḥ ।rarāja vīraiśca viniḥśvasadbhi ।rhrado bhujaṅgairiva niḥśvasadbhiḥ ॥5-5-14॥

translations.english: There were huge elephants trumpeting, respected people, warriors sighing for the lack of enemies (to vanquish). It had a lake infested with hissing snakes.
